card.name: Small words before body-part or oxygen terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'the', 'of' or an opening parenthesis, placed just before an anatomical site or an oxygen-related term. Seen in descriptions of surgery, the heart-lung machine and body landmarks.

modes.label: Before heart or body sites
modes.description: The word 'the' right before an anatomical structure like atrium, aorta, breastbone or navel.
modes.example: The heart-lung machine intercepts the blood at<< the>> right atrium (upper heart chamber)

modes.label: Oxygen balance and desaturation
modes.description: A linking word or parenthesis just before oxygen-related wording such as oxygen balance or SpO2.
